keyPoints: Saiddhantik prayikta = anukool parinam ÷ kul sambhav parinam — sab parinam samaan roop se sambhav hone chahiye, jaise nishpaksh paasa — teda paasa ya pakshpati sikka nahi chalega.
P(E) + P(E nahi) = 1 — gend laal na nikalne ki prayikta 1 se ghatakar nikalo; purak ghatna hamesha kaam aati hai — mushkil sawal aasaan ho jaata hai.
Paase ke do uchhal me kul 36 parinam — yog 7 aane ke 6 anukool parinam, to prayikta 6/36 = 1/6.
Tash ke 52 patton me: ikka 4/52, mukh patta 12/52, laal patta 26/52 — pehle prakar gino, phir sutra lagao.
Asambhav ghatna ki prayikta 0, nishchit ghatna ki 1 — iske bahar koi maan aaye to ganana galat hai.
Purak, yog, antar wale sawalon me pehle saral ghatna ki prayikta nikaalo, phir 1 se ghatao ya jodo.
Aam galti: kam se kam ek ko seedha ginna — 1 - P(ek bhi nahi) se aasaan padta hai.
